mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 70% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.3%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% year-over-year, it signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, the hypothesis fails.
